seo.title: Build Videos — Venom Guitars
seo.description: Watch Venom Guitars build custom Australian guitars from raw timber to finished instrument. Raw footage from the workshop.

s3.k2: Watch every step of the build process. No clean cuts, no studio polish — just the real craft of making guitars by hand in an Australian workshop.

s4.k4: Red Belly Black Series — Full Build Documentary
s4.k6: The full build of our first production Red Belly Black guitar. From selecting the Australian Blackwood blank through to the final setup and playthrough. This is the one that started it all. Resin art pour, full wiring, fret leveling, and the moment it finally sings.
